values: 生成斗猎围场，使其内部的所有人受到外部的治疗和伤害降低，我方角色在内部额外增加攻击力和生命汲取。
Kordan creates a hunting circle. All units inside take reduced damage and receive less healing from outside sources, while allied units inside gain extra ATK and Life Drain.

主动使用时，戈丹选择1格范围内的1名敌人，举起大剑挑战对方，使对方定身5秒，同时生成一个两人为中心的斗猎围场，对其中的所有敌人造成180% ATK伤害，并且击退围场内的其余远程敌人。
斗猎围场持续16秒，在其范围内的所有角色受到来自外部的治疗和伤害都降低60%。我方角色在斗猎围场内额外增加20% + 3%攻击力和40点生命汲取，并且造成伤害提升20% + 3%。同一时间戈丹只能维持一个斗猎围场。该技能初始拥有1000能量。

When casting this skill, Kordan raises his blade and challenges 1 enemy within 1 tile, immobilizing the target for 5s. At the same time, he summons a hunting circle around him and his target, dealing 180% ATK damage to all enemies within the circle and knocking back other ranged enemies out of the circle.
The hunting circle stays active for 16s. All units within the hunting circle take 60% less damage and healing from any outside source. Meanwhile, allied units within the circle gain 20% + 3% ATK, 40 Life Drain, and deal 20% + 3% more damage. Kordan can keep only one circle active at a time. This skill starts with 1,000 Energy.
我方角色在围场内额外增加的攻击力提升至24% + 3%，造成伤害提升增加至24% + 3%，生命汲取提升至45。
Increases the extra ATK, damage bonus, and Life Drain granted to allies within the circle to 24% + 3%, 24% + 3%, and 45 respectively.
我方角色在围场内额外增加的攻击力提升至28% + 3%，造成伤害提升增加至28% + 3%，生命汲取提升至50。
Increases the extra ATK, damage bonus, and Life Drain granted to allies within the circle to 28% + 3%, 28% + 3%, and 50 respectively.
我方角色在围场内额外增加的攻击力提升至32% + 3%，造成伤害提升增加至32% + 3%，生命汲取提升至55。
Increases the extra ATK, damage bonus, and Life Drain granted to allies within the circle to 32% + 3%, 32% + 3%, and 55 respectively.
我方角色在围场内额外增加的攻击力提升至36% + 3%，造成伤害提升增加至36% + 3%，生命汲取提升至60。
Increases the extra ATK, damage bonus, and Life Drain granted to allies within the circle to 36% + 3%, 36% + 3%, and 60 respectively.
对目标敌人造成伤害，并将伤害转化为自身护盾。
Kordan deals damage to an enemy and converts a portion of the damage dealt into a shield.
戈丹短暂蓄力后斜扫一刀对敌人造成280% + 40% ATK伤害，同时获得造成伤害100%加上300% ATK的护盾，持续15秒。

Kordan charges up briefly before unleashing a sweeping slash, dealing 280% + 40% ATK damage to an enemy. He also gains a shield equal to 100% of the damage dealt, plus an additional 300% ATK. The shield lasts 15s.
Increases the damage dealt to 340% + 40% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 400% + 40% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 460% + 40% ATK.
击倒目标敌人并造成伤害。
Kordan knocks down an enemy, dealing damage.
戈丹跳起后从上方劈下，对敌人造成350% + 50% ATK伤害并将其击倒。
Kordan leaps high, slamming his blade down on the enemy to deal 350% + 50% ATK damage and knock them down.
Increases the damage dealt to 400% + 50% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 450% + 50% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 500% + 50% ATK.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升12%。
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升16%。
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升20%。
在斗猎围场内击败敌人会使自身其他技能永久升级。
The first time Kordan assists or defeats an enemy within the hunting circle, he permanently enhances other skills.

戈丹在斗猎围场内第一次参与击败非召唤物敌人，或在斗猎围场内累计作战20秒后，使技能“踏锋饮血”和“崩裂斩”获得升级。 
踏锋饮血：额外附带目标当前已损失生命值30%的额外伤害。额外伤害最高不超过戈丹600% ATK。
崩裂斩：戈丹会在跳起时将敌人击飞，并将击倒时间延长至2秒，同时额外造成300% ATK的伤害。

When Kordan achieves his first assist or defeat of a non-summoned enemy within the hunting circle, or after he has fought inside the circle for 20s, his Fury Slash and Sundering Strike become enhanced. 
Enhanced Fury Slash: Deals extra damage equal to 30% of the target's lost HP, up to 600% ATK.
Enhanced Sundering Strike: Allows Kordan to also knock his target into the air, increasing the duration of the subsequent knockdown for 2s and dealing 300% ATK extra damage.
“踏锋饮血”的额外伤害提升至目标当前已损失生命值35%。额外伤害最高不超过戈丹700% ATK。“崩裂斩”的额外伤害提升至350%。
Increases the extra damage dealt by Fury Slash to 35% of the target's lost HP, up to 700% ATK. Also increases the extra damage dealt by Sundering Strike to 350%.
每当戈丹在斗猎围场内参与击败非召唤物敌人时，自身永久提高40%的护甲与魔抗，最多叠加3次，同时在后续的3秒内每秒回复自身15%最大生命值。

Each assist or defeat Kordan achieves against a non-summoned enemy inside the hunting circle permanently increases his Phys & Magic DEF by 40%, stacking up to 3 times. Each assist or defeat also restores 15% of his max HP every second for 3s.
“踏锋饮血”的额外伤害提升至目标当前已损失生命值40%。额外伤害最高不超过戈丹800% ATK。“崩裂斩”的额外伤害提升至400%。
Increases the extra damage dealt by Fury Slash to 40% of the target's lost HP, up to 800% ATK. Also increases the extra damage dealt by Sundering Strike to 400%.
在斗猎围场内击败敌人后可以跳向其他敌人，并移动其位置。
Whenever Kordan assists or defeats an enemy inside the hunting circle, he leaps to a new target and moves the circle to his new position.
每当戈丹在斗猎围场内参与击败敌人时，戈丹可以跳向下一个敌人并将斗猎围场移动到脚下，同时使斗猎围场的持续时间额外增加10秒。我方角色在围场内额外增加50点穿透。

Whenever Kordan assists or defeats an enemy inside the hunting circle, he leaps to a new target and moves the circle to his new position. Repositioning the circle extends its duration by 10s. All allies within the circle also gain 50 Penetration.
